faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to have a website ready?
faq.a1: Usually between 2 and 4 weeks, depending on complexity and whether you already have the texts and materials ready.
faq.q2: Why do you use n8n for automations?
faq.a2: Because it allows connecting hundreds of applications visually and quickly, which reduces maintenance costs for you.
faq.q3: Do I have to pay monthly maintenance?
faq.a3: It's not mandatory. Once I deliver the project it's 100% yours, but I offer optional plans so you don't have to worry about updates.
